## Description

A recall date per patient (default six months after the last check-up or cleaning), a due list for reception and reminders through the existing channels.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Reminders respect the patient's reminder consent and carry no clinical detail.
- [ ] **AC2.** Booking a recall visit clears the recall.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
